steps.name: Fault injection and recovery matrix
steps.objective: Extend the end-to-end harness with deterministic process crashes, truncated JSONLines, delayed responses, duplicate captures, and restart recovery. Preserve exact component revisions and never call an unfunded provider.
acceptance: Every injected fault has an expected safe state and repeatable recovery check
No stale or duplicate result mutates the accepted document revision
All evidence identifies fixture versus live-provider behavior

steps.name: Compatibility and performance gate
steps.objective: Integrate the corpus and PDF evidence into a single non-regression command with measured cold, warm, edit, capture, and export timings. Keep unsupported constructs explicit and reject evidence from stale component SHAs.
acceptance: Gate distinguishes new passes, regressions, unsupported cases, and unverified visual/device behavior
Latency results include sample counts and exact environment rather than unsupported targets
A component SHA mismatch or missing native evidence fails closed
